comparison.shape: exact after selecting the declared valid region
comparison.final_rgba: all four decoder channels before clipping, compositing or byte conversion

valid_regions.vision: all 256 tokens for each of four outputs
valid_regions.text: processed token rows before fixed padding, including template rows
valid_regions.denoiser_component: all expanded joint rows before fixed padding
valid_regions.fixed_step_target: the exact 1024 target positions from the frozen layout
valid_regions.vae_decoder: all four unclipped channels and spatial positions

decision_basis: Engineering acceptance budgets, not theoretical rounding bounds or per-element ULP limits.
Existing Float32 component limits are unchanged. New low-precision component budgets use epsilon and four epsilon as chosen global normalized-error budgets.
Existing final-latent and RGBA output budgets from verify.py:75-77 are retained for every precision. No epsilon-times-step-count bound is assumed.
Two source repeat runs had zero observed differences; this does not bound all inputs or cross-runtime error.
prior_observations: FP32, FP16, BF16 and W4 real-block feasibility probes were already observed before this policy.
The old FP32-gate failures remain unchanged. New-policy acceptance requires new full-suite runs; reclassification of old probes is insufficient.
The full mixed FP16-network/FP32-VAE source suite completed; its output quality is unreviewed. Full BF16 source evaluation has not run.
requirements: B and C share exact quantized weights and dequantization parameters, per-component compute dtype, normalization, clipping, noise, tokens, layouts and sigmas.
Select each component budget from that component compute dtype; a Float32 VAE retains the Float32 budget even in an otherwise Float16 profile.
Every applicable output tensor and all eight fixed-input denoiser steps must pass independently in each of 60 runs; no mean pass rate hides a failure.
In free rollout B and C each use their own preceding latent from the same initial noise and conditions; final latent and RGBA must both pass in each run.
Generation-only rows mark vision and VAE encoder as not applicable with a reason; editing requires them.
Nonfloat token/index/mask/shape/sigma equality is exact and outside floating tolerances.
Independent source, same-quantized-weight reference and conversion evidence must be complete and input-bound before a profile can be verified.
A0-to-A1 and A1-to-B differences are descriptive with independent finite/quality checks; they are not conversion-error comparisons.
Human quality ratings require at least 90% success per applicable axis and at most two outputs with a newly failed axis; unreviewed ratings fail completeness.
Do not automatically widen budgets after failure. A policy change requires a new version, reasons, affected comparisons and new runs; retain old results.
